# Fixtures for `jwt` (JSON Web Token)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour, reserved `.example` domains): an HS256 token signed with the published key "saltmere-demo", expired on 2000-01-01. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/crypto.sh`.
